description: For infinite \(\kappa\), a nonempty \(\kappa\)-saturated target \(N\), and a nonempty source \(M\) with \(|M|\le\kappa\), every specified partial elementary map \(f:A\to N\) with \(|A|<\kappa\) extends to an elementary embedding \(e:M\to N\) whose value at every old \(a\in A\) is exactly \(f(a)\). The size of \(N\) is unrestricted.
